name: Shedd Aquarium
tagline: Sea otters first, then Wild Reef sharks and jellies — rockhopper and Magellanic penguins, not African.

practical.ticket_note: CityPASS and timed tickets available; weekends busy.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Shedd bonus · sea otters + Wild Reef + jellies

challenges.text: Sea otter: snack on the belly or a back float?
Wild Reef: count the fins you can see at once.
Jellies: watch one pulse from top to bottom.
Flamboyant cuttlefish: which color did it try first?
